description: Localized tutorial text: in-battle practice task messages and command-button labels (TUT_INGAME_TASK_*), plus the configuration/tutorial screen labels and help messages (TUT_INGAME_LABEL_*/MESSAGE_*).

ID.simple: Tutorial text id (row key), e.g. TUT_INGAME_TASK_MESSAGE_0001.
ID.technical: FName ID of FGameDataTableRow_GameText, used as the FindRow key. Battle tutorial tasks are hard-coded in FStudioBattleSystem390 setup as FNames in FStudioBattleTutorialTask.Message/CommandLabel; UGameBattleHUDWidget/UGameBattlePracticeTaskListWidget pass them to UGameBattlePracticeTaskWidget::SetTask, which calls SetTextIdOnly on the detail and command text blocks. Config tutorial rows are added from literal TUT_INGAME_LABEL_* ids in GameConfigTutorialWidget. The table is loaded as TutorialTextDataTable_<Language> in slot 10 of the 14-table GameText array.

Text.simple: The localized tutorial instruction or key-command icon label.
Text.technical: FString row text (+0x10), resolved through the normal GetText/SetTextIdOnly pipeline and FormatText. This group mixes plain instructions, glossary substitutions (13 occurrences in the En export) and rich-text image markup such as or + for command labels. A NAME_None MessageId/CommandLabelId hides the corresponding text widget rather than showing an empty row. All 163 companion-export rows are nonempty in every language. Embedded newlines in longer help messages follow the GameText_JoinLines behavior.

notes: FGameDataTableRow_GameText with 11 exported language variants (163 identical ids each). Slot 10 in GameTextManager::Tick; Config/DefaultGame.ini:35-45 cooks one variant per language chunk.

Battle tutorial definitions are compiled C++ (GameBattleSystems_B.cpp:1400-1896), not read from a tutorial task data table; they supply the TUT_ ids to widgets. Config tutorial labels are also literal ids in GameConfigTutorialWidget.cpp:28-43. Both ultimately call the same text manager path, so the data table is the single localization source.

GLO tags in tutorial messages resolve through the GlossaryTextDataTable_ parameter map; tags are handled by the rich-text markup parser, not by FormatText (FormatText only matches patterns and would leave img tags for the widget parser).

Reconstruction caveat: FindTextRow/Tick are behaviour-certified rather than byte-identical (status/functions.json 0x14af290, 0x14c96f0; BEHAV BG03); GetText/FormatText are byte-matched. Partial Content; no claims about all retail or Blueprint-only uses.

usages.detail: Constructs FStudioBattleTutorialTask entries with literal TUT_INGAME_TASK_MESSAGE_* and COMMAND_LABEL_* ids.
Passes the task's Message and CommandLabel ids into UGameBattlePracticeTaskWidget::SetTask.
Sets the task detail text block from the message id and hides it when the id is None.
Sets the command label text block from the command id and controls its visibility.
Adds TUT_INGAME_LABEL_0001..0011 and 0101..0201 rows to the configuration tutorial screen with section indices.
Loads TutorialTextDataTable_<Language> into the shared GameText search array.
